title: Connect a hardware wallet without exposing its backup

summary.text: Pairing a device and restoring its recovery backup into desktop software are different operations. Keep hardware-wallet recovery material on its intended secure recovery path.

problem.text: Ledger Trezor not connecting not detected pairing firmware bridge

symptoms.text: Ledger Trezor not connecting not detected pairing firmware bridge

user_phrases.text: Ledger Trezor not connecting not detected pairing firmware bridge

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Use the hardware-wallet pairing flow with the intended device. Follow its unlock and Cardano application prompts; confirm device actions only when you initiated them.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Read the exact state or error. For a failed connection, the checked interface suggests reconnecting the device.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: For unsupported firmware, bridge or software errors, ask support for instructions matching your device and platform. This guide does not establish firmware compatibility or prescribe updates.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: The device reaches its ready state, or you have an exact connection error for staff. Never type a hardware-wallet recovery phrase into Ariadne or a desktop troubleshooting form.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Use the genuine application and keep private backups private.
consequences: Changing or approving wallet operations can affect funds.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.
